results.exact_statement: The target-sufficient admissible product is exactly product_v h_v, where h_v=(L(v)/2)/r_v^((k_v-1)/n). Universal per-cherry and per-rooted-subtree inequalities are stronger than the parent requires: an uncertified cherry with an admissible parent can remain open as multiplicative debt in its ancestor block. All 126 corpus misses and 178/180 stress misses are internal in this sense; only a miss whose parent is the virtual level-one cut is a genuine standalone base. The corpus has zero such terminal misses and stress has two, with largest sampled factor 0.853771268558. A deterministic cubic also falsifies naive independent substitution of each certified cherry's standalone sqrt(B_v) majorant: the actual subtree product is 0.839217266469 but the hybrid bound is 1.075474341153. The exact open throat is therefore parent-coupled area/capacity or another adaptive open-block closure that retains certified-child slack, with only virtual-cut misses treated separately.

results.exact_statement: For every admissible merge node v, with next admissible ancestor or level-one cut b_v, complete admissible rooted subtree T_v, N_v=|T_v|, and q(u)=L(u)/(2 beta_u^(1/n)), CSTA specializes to CAQ at a maximal component and to h_v<=1 at a cherry. For delta_v=N_v(1-Phi_v), x_v=(beta_v/b_v)^(1/n), and G_v=L(v)/2+N_v-1-N_v x_v, exact algebra gives delta_v=x_v^(-1)(sum_i delta_(v_i)-G_v). Moreover C_v=x_v^N_v-N_v x_v+N_v-1=(1-x_v)^2 sum_(j=0)^(N_v-2)(N_v-1-j)x_v^j>=0 and O_v=max(0,L(v)/2-x_v^N_v)=x_v^N_v max(0,h_v-1), so G_v<=C_v+O_v. Thus PGLS, sum_i delta_(v_i)>=C_v+O_v, is a stronger sufficient recursive step. CSTA and PGLS are unproved. PGLS has zero base/stress violations with largest measured liability/slack ratios 0.857114446951 and 0.960626426260; a fixed half-slack allocation is numerically false.
